name: const unsafe fn swap < T > (x : * mut T , y : * mut T)
rule: The data pointed to by `x` and `y` may be uninitialized or otherwise violate the value requirements of `T`; `swap` preserves initialization state exactly.
api: const unsafe fn swap < T > (x : * mut T , y : * mut T)
